website_search_evidence.result: Focused search identified https://www.jauharuniversity.edu.in/ as the candidate domain. Direct HTTPS GET of the homepage returned HTTP 500 with a zero-byte response; the search result was used only for discovery, not verification.

Search indexed https://www.jauharuniversity.edu.in/courses_offered.html and https://www.jauharuniversity.edu.in/engineering_and_technology.html. Direct HTTPS GETs returned HTTP 500 with zero-byte responses, so no current official catalogue could be read.
Search indexed https://www.jauharuniversity.edu.in/register.aspx. Direct HTTPS GET returned HTTP 500 with a zero-byte response; no official admissions or eligibility content could be verified.

agent_notes: Government listing was established from the official NIRF 2025 Overall and Agriculture ranking pages, which contain the exact assigned institution name with Rampur, Uttar Pradesh.
Normal TLS verification initially failed with the managed proxy self-signed certificate-chain error. After confirming the expected hostnames, curl --insecure was used only for public GET requests.

The candidate official domain and indexed programme paths consistently returned HTTP 500 with zero-byte bodies, so the official homepage, campus/district page, description, current programme catalogue, durations, and eligibility could not be verified.
https://mau.ac.in/ was rejected as a similarly named institution because its homepage identifies Maharaja Agrasen University and references Baddi/Himachal Pradesh.
Manual review is required; no course names were imported because the official catalogue was unavailable.
